description.en: Local control of Bang & Olufsen Mozart speakers (Beosound Emerge, Balance, Level, A5, A9 5th gen, ...). Discovery, transport, volume, source and radio-favourite control, plus Beolink multiroom.

value.en: This integration controls Bang & Olufsen 'Mozart' platform speakers on your local network (e.g. Beosound Emerge). Press Next to scan your network for speakers.
